controls.title: Tenant isolation
controls.claim: Every table holding your data carries its organisation, down to individual chat messages and audit rows. One restrictive database policy per table means a session reads only organisations it belongs to. Restrictive policies filter; they never grant.
controls.evidence: supabase/tests/rls/org_isolation.sql asserts org A reads and writes zero rows of org B, even holding a global producer role. It runs on every pull request.

controls.title: Roles and rights
controls.claim: Three roles per organisation. Every read and write is authorised in the database; the interface only decides what to draw. Nine rights are marked sensitive and ask for a second confirmation before they take effect. Nine ship switched off until an administrator turns them on.
controls.evidence: 28 rights across 8 groups. The two sets overlap but are not the same: issuing and voiding hire orders are sensitive yet on, because a production team that cannot issue an order cannot work.

controls.title: Encryption and secrets
controls.claim: TLS in transit, encryption at rest in managed Postgres. Integration keys live in a secrets vault and are readable only by server functions, never by members of your organisation.
controls.evidence: The Airtable key is written to Supabase Vault through an admin-guarded function and is never read back to a client.

controls.title: Auditability
controls.claim: Booking changes are appended to a log: who acted, what changed, the reason given, the timestamp. Administrators and the production team can read it; no policy on the table permits an update or a delete.
controls.evidence: Retained three years from the show date, per section 7 of the privacy policy.

controls.title: Application security
controls.claim: Role checks run as security-definer database functions rather than being scattered through queries. Every pull request is scanned for committed secrets, and dependency updates arrive as grouped weekly pull requests.
controls.evidence: Checks concentrated in has_org_role, is_org_member, is_capability_enabled, is_feature_enabled, and capability_default — one place to audit.

controls.title: Backups
controls.claim: Managed Postgres with a rolling 30-day backup window. Data deleted from the live database leaves the backups inside that window.
controls.evidence: Stated in section 7 of the privacy policy.

selfServeRights.title: Export your data
selfServeRights.detail: A machine-readable export of everything tied to your account, from your profile page. Art. 15 and 20.

selfServeRights.title: Withdraw analytics consent
selfServeRights.detail: Analytics, session replay, and error tracking stop immediately. Art. 7(3).

selfServeRights.title: Delete your account
selfServeRights.detail: Removes your account and anonymises what must be retained for booking records. Art. 17.

selfServeRights.title: Object or restrict
selfServeRights.detail: One address, one month to answer, no ticket queue. Art. 18 and 21.
